observations_already_seen: Data coverage only: 298113 total documents, 108518 eligible, 107666 complete. No V15 model performance or IC has been run.

quality_revision.reason: Targets are defined only for point-in-time eligible stocks, whereas the original denominator includes all historical-union events. Ineligible events have intentionally undefined sector-relative targets.
quality_revision.denominator: ALL events with eligible=true at event date, including immature or incomplete eligible events; no filtering by target availability
quality_revision.numerator: eligible events with finite 1/5/20-day targets and present, ordered future label end dates
quality_revision.all_event_ratio: retain and report the original 36.1158 percent separately; do not relabel it as passing
quality_revision.coverage_gates: unchanged: 250000 total documents, 750 total symbols, observed by 2017-01-31, no duplicate keys
quality_revision.additional_safety: nonempty eligible denominator; no invalid eligibility, blank documents, nonpositive raw event counts, invalid event dates or invalid label chronology

correctness_revision: Preserve caller row alignment when returning validation predictions.
Use the identical V13-style 80/20 two-stage/V10-global baseline in validation and final scoring; V15 remains 75 percent baseline and 25 percent text.
All inherited fitting inputs are restricted to labels matured before cutoff minus 28 calendar days; outer validation targets must also mature before the outer test cutoff minus embargo.
Count available years from raw eligible positive-count events, independently from complete mature training-event years. Never infer event years from ranked values.
Normalize recent text within the current point-in-time eligible stock universe and current sector; exclude zero-count, future and out-of-scope events.
Include initial capital when calculating sampled-period drawdown; report that this is not a daily mark-to-market drawdown.
unchanged: Titles, target values, corpus, blend weights, model hyperparameters, transaction costs, performance thresholds, test years and V14 frozen files remain unchanged.
limitations: Announcement titles are text representations, not full announcement bodies or a pretrained language model. Historical 2020-2025 years have already been explored in earlier versions; this run is retrospective research, not an unseen future holdout.
